Take-up Units

UCTM Series

A take-up unit that accepts a UC bearing insert. Available in sizes 204–212 with two stroke options — a short adjustment distance (A) and a long adjustment distance (B) — and mainly used in belt conveyor lines. The 215A/B and 216A/B are made to order. The stainless-steel housing version of the same specification (SUS-TM), as well as the press-formed steel-plate housing versions TFU and SUS-TFU, are also summarized below.
